---
name: Change proposal
about: Propose a focused documentation, experiment, feature, or fix task.
---

## Problem and motivation

What needs to change, and why?

## Proposed scope

Describe the change and what is outside scope. Use synthetic examples only;
never attach private datasets, credentials, or secrets.

## Acceptance criteria

List observable outcomes and relevant validation.

## Architecture and decisions

Link related Issues or approved design decisions when applicable. State whether
this follows the approved plan or requires a new decision before implementation.
